# Read Primitives — Primary Key GroupBy


> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

GROUP BY on primary key (one row per group)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* GROUP BY on primary key (one row per group) */ SELECT c_custkey, MAX(c_name) AS customer_name FROM customer GROUP BY c_custkey
```
